inputs.description: Pasted table with three columns: Component (P/O/W/E), Policy and Interventions
Chat answers of 2026-11-22: year 2024 then 2022 and 2024; EU and OECD countries only; fetch all MPOWER indicators; asked for the summary indicator of each dimension

countries.value: EU and OECD countries: 43 (EU27 and OECD38, 22 in both)

breakdown.value: National level; by sex or product where the WHO table has that dimension

scoping.retrieval_strategy: Retrieve everything MPOWER publishes for the 43 countries: all 33 TOBACCO_MPOWER_* tables (overview with the seven _Group composites, every component table of M, P, O, W, E and R, and NTCP), plus the 22 compliance scores published only as single indicators (P_compl_*, E_compl_*, last value 2022). One request per table, filtered on the 43 countries and 2022-2024 (about 25,000 rows). Composites and compliance scores are retrieved as published and never recomputed.

questions.text: Combination NRT, patch alone and fast-acting NRT look like inputs for an effect model. Do you need intervention effect sizes? Those come from trials and reviews (e.g. Cochrane), not from WHO monitoring data.
questions.default: Retrieve country policy data only; R8-R10 parked as 'effect sizes, separate literature task'.

questions.text: MPOWER P covers smoking only. Should we look for a separate WHO source on e-cigarette regulation in Stage 2?
questions.default: Smoking only for now; vaping regulation listed for Stage 2.

questions.text: No GHO indicator exists for workplace cessation. Drop it, or look for another source?
By 'school tobacco', do you mean (a) smoke-free school law, (b) youth tobacco use, or (c) school prevention programmes?
M and R are not in your list. Retrieve only their composite scores (they come free with the overview table), or also their bundles?
questions.answer: fetch all of the MPOWER indicators, for OECD and EU countries

questions.text: Coverage: all 195 countries and report years 2007-2024?
questions.answer: Year must be 2024, only EU and OECD countries. / We include 2022 too, as well.

questions.text: Include age-standardised current tobacco use prevalence by sex (M_Est_tob_curr_std) as context?
For P, use P_compl_all_sfe (2022) as the only compliance score available?

catalogue_lookups.result: One row per country x report year x question (Dim1 = TOBACCO_INDICATOR_<question>); report years 2007-2024
33 MPOWER tables; all countries and years together about 380,000 rows
SHS_*: 8 rows, WHO regions, 2004 only. TOBACCO_0000000344/346: no data.

analytical_notes.note: Whether to model the P provisions jointly, or use P_Group, is an analysis decision. Retrieving the full P bundles keeps both options open.
The meaning of each MPOWER level (1-5) and of the compliance scores must be read from the technical notes of the WHO report on the global tobacco epidemic before analysis.

research.geographic_coverage: 43 countries: EU27 and OECD38 (22 in both)
analytical_applications: Cross-country comparison of tobacco control policies
stated_by_user: Fetch all of the MPOWER indicators
Wants the summary (compliance) indicator of each dimension
assumptions: OECD membership taken as the 38 members known on 2026-11-22; a new member would need adding
Parked rows follow the Q1-Q4 defaults

sources.rate_limits: Not documented; requests are spaced 0.5 s apart
sources.metadata_available: Indicator names; dimension labels (DIMENSION/{type}/DimensionValues), including the 264 TOBACCO_INDICATOR question titles. No units or definitions.
sources.update_frequency: With each WHO report on the global tobacco epidemic (biennial)

expected_data_structure: Long format: one row per table x country x report year x question (TOBACCO_INDICATOR dimension, labelled with the question title), plus sex or product where the table has it. Answers stay as text in value_text; numeric answers also in value. Optional wide country-year panel.

missing_value_codes.note: WHO has no value for this country, year and question.
missing_value_codes.evidence: value-codes on test run WHO_MPOWER_policies_20261122_182912: 3,614 rows in 39 indicators (all tables and the compliance scores).

missing_value_codes.note: Follow-up question skipped because the parent question was answered 'No'. Kept as a category, not as missing.
missing_value_codes.evidence: Cross-tab on the same run: every country with O_Avail_hosp = 'No' has O_Ins_hosp = '—'. value-codes on test run WHO_MPOWER_policies_20261122_182912: 1,215 rows in 15 indicators.

missing_value_codes.note: WHO states the score or question does not apply (for example no ban to comply with). Kept as a category, not as missing.
missing_value_codes.evidence: value-codes on test run WHO_MPOWER_policies_20261122_182912: 151 rows in 21 indicators, mostly compliance scores (E_compl_*, P_compl_*) where the country has no such ban or law, so there is nothing to comply with.

known_limitations: Several tables exist only in the 2024 report (M1-M4, R tax structure, revenue, administration, earmarking): no 2022 values.

Compliance scores are published for P and E only. Per-item and P scores are single indicators whose latest value is 2022; in 2024 only the two overall E scores exist, inside E1 and E2. The 2022 and 2024 E scores are separate assessments with different values.
Compliance scores are missing ('. . .') for many countries (e.g. 14 of 43 for the 2024 E scores).
The 2024 _Group levels exist only in TOBACCO_MPOWER_OVERVIEW; the single _Group codes stop in 2022.
Levels, scores and Yes/No answers are categories kept as text; no conversion or recomputation (R7).
MPOWER does not cover vaping in smoke-free laws, second-hand smoke exposure, workplace cessation or NRT forms (rows R3, R4, R8-R10, R14, R20 parked).
M_Est_tob_curr_std includes modelled estimates; 2023 is left out to keep to the report years.
